content.title: UCLA wins the 2026 DI women's basketball championship
content.text: UCLA won its first NCAA women's basketball championship, defeating fellow No. 1 seed South Carolina 79-51 on April 5. The 2026 tournament featured an all-No. 1 seed Final Four for the fifth time in women's tournament history. UCLA cruised past Texas, and South Carolina handed UConn its first loss of the season en route to the title game. Games started with the First Four beginning Wednesday, March 18 and cotinued through the national championship on April 5. 2026 NCAA women's basketball tournament bracket Click or tap here for a
